title: Plasma closes windows one by one on Wayland during restart -> losing browser tabs
line: After logging out of a Wayland session, a Chrome, Chromium, Vivaldi or other Chromium-based browser that had several windows open now brings all of them back instead of only the last one.
explanation: On Wayland logout, plasma-shutdown asks KWin (org.kde.KWin.Session.closeWaylandWindows) to close every window, and KWin sends each one the same close request as Alt+F4. Chromium-based browsers take each of those as the user closing that window while others are still open and drop it from their saved session (Chromium issue 580139203), so only the last window came back; Firefox handles the same closes fine. KWin now leaves the windows of a Chromium-based browser with several windows alone while the other apps close and the logout can still be cancelled; once it can't (every other window closed, Log Out Anyway, or the 2-minute timeout) it sends the browser SIGTERM, which Chromium handles as quitting the whole app, keeping every window, and waits up to 10 s for it before letting the logout go on. Firefox, single-window browsers and all other apps get the same close requests as before.

commits.message:
sm: Quit Chromium browsers as a whole at logout

Chromium-based browsers drop windows closed one by one at logout from
their session. A browser with several windows is now left open until
the logout can't be cancelled, then asked to quit with SIGTERM.

BUG: 511236

media.caption: Master, Chrome: windows A (2 tabs), B and C open (left); after the logout close and starting Chrome again only C comes back (right)
With the fix, same steps: A (with both tabs), B and C all come back
Master, Firefox 160 with three windows: all three come back
With the fix, Firefox still gets the normal close requests and still brings back all three windows
Master, Chrome with three windows plus Konsole running a program: while Konsole asks, Chrome's windows are already closed (left), so after pressing Cancel Logout only Konsole is left (right)
With the fix, same steps: Chrome is left alone while the logout can be cancelled, and after Cancel Logout all three Chrome windows are still open
Master, Chrome with one window and unsaved text in a page that asks before leaving: logout shows 'Leave site?'
With the fix, a browser with a single window still gets the close request and still asks 'Leave site?'
Master, Chrome with three windows plus Konsole: Chrome's windows are closed one by one before Log Out Anyway is even pressed, losing A and B as in the first picture
With the fix, pressing Log Out Anyway (left) makes Chrome quit as a whole, and starting it again brings back A, B and C (right)
